dedupe_keys.name: ze190612 gametheory research on game theoretic behavior of collective emergency evacuation in wildfire under the drive of individual risk perception

description: The gametheory repository author publishes Python scripts for collective evacuation decisions under wildfire risk. Zenodo archives version 1.0.0 under CC BY 4.0 and links the public repository. Its README maps separate scripts to equilibrium payoffs under clear and ambiguous conditions, population-size changes, congestion-function sensitivity and variation in individual risk perception. This model can test how information ambiguity or route congestion alters evacuation choices in a stylised emergency simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this game-theoretic package. Coverage is the paper’s assumed route and population scenarios, not observed wildfire evacuation in a named community. A limitation is that the Zenodo page itself has no description and the README gives a table-reproduction map, not complete parameter provenance. Game payoffs and risk preferences must be assessed before applying the model elsewhere. No archive was downloaded and no equilibrium or table value was independently recalculated.
